cause_quote: The commit removed `entry.refreshAt = Date.now() + AGENT_IDENTITY_CACHE_TTL_MS`, so a successful identity read no longer expired after 60 seconds.
user_saw: After a successful Gateway save of IDENTITY.md, an open Control UI tab could keep showing the agent’s old name or avatar.
summary: The fix broadcasts committed identity-file saves so open Control UI tabs refresh the affected agent without resuming idle polling.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #167968 and confirmed that both file-save RPCs already existed and that the shared UI cache re-read identity after its 60-second freshness window. The pre-change test covered picking up a replacement avatar without an event. Removing expiration left Gateway saves without a way to invalidate the cached identity in open tabs.
